create_model_generate_response: create a Model instance to generate responses from OpenAI or Anthropic language models
create_anthropic_model: create an AnthropicModel instance with a specific Claude model and API key for text completion
test_fake_model: test a FakeModel with static or sequential responses for unit testing language model integrations
build_model_load: build a Model instance that loads OpenAI, Anthropic, or echo language models from string names
review_model_generate: review the Model.generate method that handles retries, timeouts, and prompt formatting for LLM calls
